commands.name: mlx_lm
commands.help:
The supported subcommands are ('benchmark', 'cache_prompt', 'chat', 'convert', 'evaluate', 'fuse', 'generate', 'lora', 'manage', 'perplexity', 'awq', 'dwq', 'dynamic_quant', 'gptq', 'server', 'upload', 'share')

For help on an individual subcommand, pass --help to the subcommand. For example: mlx_lm.generate --help

commands.name: mlx_lm.awq
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.awq [-h] [--model MODEL] [--mlx-path MLX_PATH] [--bits BITS]
                  [--group-size GROUP_SIZE] [--embed-bits EMBED_BITS]
                  [--embed-group-size EMBED_GROUP_SIZE] [--num-samples NUM_SAMPLES]
                  [--sequence-length SEQUENCE_LENGTH] [--n-grid N_GRID] [--seed SEED]
                  [--trust-remote-code]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL, -m MODEL
  --mlx-path MLX_PATH
  --bits BITS
  --group-size GROUP_SIZE
  --embed-bits EMBED_BITS
  --embed-group-size EMBED_GROUP_SIZE
  --num-samples NUM_SAMPLES
  --sequence-length SEQUENCE_LENGTH
  --n-grid N_GRID
  --seed SEED
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading.

commands.name: mlx_lm.benchmark
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.benchmark [-h] [--model MODEL] [--prompt-tokens PROMPT_TOKENS]
                        [--generation-tokens GENERATION_TOKENS] [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
                        [--num-trials NUM_TRIALS] [--pipeline] [--quantize-activations]
                        [--prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE] [--delay DELAY]
                        [--trust-remote-code]

LLM benchmarking script

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         The path to the local model directory or Hugging Face repo. If no model is
                        specified, then mlx-community/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit is used.
  --prompt-tokens PROMPT_TOKENS, -p PROMPT_TOKENS
                        Length of prompt
  --generation-tokens GENERATION_TOKENS, -g GENERATION_TOKENS
                        Length of completion
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE, -b BATCH_SIZE
                        Batch size
  --num-trials NUM_TRIALS, -n NUM_TRIALS
                        Number of timing trials
  --pipeline            Use pipelining instead of tensor parallelism
  --quantize-activations, -qa
                        Quantize activations using the same quantization config as the
                        corresponding layer.
  --prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE
                        Step size for prefill processing (default: 2048)
  --delay DELAY         Delay between each test in seconds (default: 0)
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading.

commands.name: mlx_lm.cache_prompt
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.cache_prompt [-h] [--model MODEL] [--adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH]
                           [--trust-remote-code] [--eos-token EOS_TOKEN]
                           [--max-kv-size MAX_KV_SIZE] --prompt-cache-file PROMPT_CACHE_FILE
                           --prompt PROMPT [--kv-bits KV_BITS] [--kv-group-size KV_GROUP_SIZE]
                           [--quantized-kv-start QUANTIZED_KV_START]

Cache the state of a prompt to be reused with mlx_lm.generate

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         The path to the local model directory or Hugging Face repo.
  --adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH
                        Optional path for the trained adapter weights and config.
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer
  --eos-token EOS_TOKEN
                        End of sequence token for tokenizer
  --max-kv-size MAX_KV_SIZE
                        Set the maximum key-value cache size
  --prompt-cache-file PROMPT_CACHE_FILE
                        The file to save the prompt cache in
  --prompt PROMPT       Message to be processed by the model ('-' reads from stdin)
  --kv-bits KV_BITS     Number of bits for KV cache quantization. Defaults to no quantization.
  --kv-group-size KV_GROUP_SIZE
                        Group size for KV cache quantization.
  --quantized-kv-start QUANTIZED_KV_START
                        When --kv-bits is set, start quantizing the KV cache from this step
                        onwards.

commands.name: mlx_lm.chat
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.chat [-h] [--model MODEL] [--trust-remote-code] [--adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH]
                   [--temp TEMP] [--top-p TOP_P] [--xtc-probability XTC_PROBABILITY]
                   [--xtc-threshold XTC_THRESHOLD] [--seed SEED] [--max-kv-size MAX_KV_SIZE]
                   [--prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]
                   [--system-prompt SYSTEM_PROMPT] [--pipeline]

Chat with an LLM

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         The path to the local model directory or Hugging Face repo.
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer
  --adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH
                        Optional path for the trained adapter weights and config.
  --temp TEMP           Sampling temperature
  --top-p TOP_P         Sampling top-p
  --xtc-probability XTC_PROBABILITY
                        Probability of XTC sampling to happen each next token
  --xtc-threshold XTC_THRESHOLD
                        Thresold the probs of each next token candidate to be sampled by XTC
  --seed SEED           PRNG seed
  --max-kv-size MAX_KV_SIZE
                        Set the maximum key-value cache size
  --prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE
                        Number of prompt tokens to process at a time. Smaller values lower peak
                        memory during prefill (default: 2048)
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS, -m MAX_TOKENS
                        Maximum number of tokens to generate
  --system-prompt SYSTEM_PROMPT
                        System prompt to be used for the chat template
  --pipeline            Use pipelining instead of tensor parallelism

commands.name: mlx_lm.convert
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.convert [-h] [--hf-path HF_PATH] [--mlx-path MLX_PATH] [-q]
                      [--q-group-size Q_GROUP_SIZE] [--q-bits Q_BITS]
                      [--q-mode {affine,mxfp4,nvfp4,mxfp8}]
                      [--quant-predicate {mixed_2_6,mixed_3_4,mixed_3_6,mixed_4_6}]
                      [--dtype {float16,bfloat16,float32}] [--upload-repo UPLOAD_REPO] [-d]
                      [--trust-remote-code]

Convert Hugging Face model to MLX format

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --hf-path HF_PATH, --model HF_PATH
                        Path to the model. This can be a local path or a Hugging Face Hub model
                        identifier.
  --mlx-path MLX_PATH   Path to save the MLX model.
  -q, --quantize        Generate a quantized model.
  --q-group-size Q_GROUP_SIZE
                        Group size for quantization.
  --q-bits Q_BITS       Bits per weight for quantization.
  --q-mode {affine,mxfp4,nvfp4,mxfp8}
                        The quantization mode.
  --quant-predicate {mixed_2_6,mixed_3_4,mixed_3_6,mixed_4_6}
                        Mixed-bit quantization recipe.
  --dtype {float16,bfloat16,float32}
                        Type to save the non-quantized parameters. Defaults to config.json's
                        `torch_dtype` or the current model weights dtype.
  --upload-repo UPLOAD_REPO
                        The Hugging Face repo to upload the model to.
  -d, --dequantize      Dequantize a quantized model.
  --trust-remote-code   Trust remote code when loading tokenizer.

commands.name: mlx_lm.dwq
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.dwq [-h] --model MODEL [--quantized-model QUANTIZED_MODEL] [--mlx-path MLX_PATH]
                  [--bits BITS] [--group-size GROUP_SIZE] [--num-samples NUM_SAMPLES]
                  [--max-seq-length MAX_SEQ_LENGTH] [--seed SEED] [--learning-rate LEARNING_RATE]
                  [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE] [--data-path DATA_PATH] [--grad-checkpoint]
                  [--target-dir TARGET_DIR] [--targets-only] [--pipeline] [--trust-remote-code]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL, -m MODEL
                        A model to distill from for DWQ. If `quantized-model` is not given the
                        student model will be this model quantized according to `bits` and `group-
                        size`.
  --quantized-model QUANTIZED_MODEL
                        An already quantized model (the student model) to improve with DWQ.
  --mlx-path MLX_PATH   Path to save the quantized model.
  --bits BITS           Bits per weight for quantization.
  --group-size GROUP_SIZE
                        Group size for quantization.
  --num-samples NUM_SAMPLES
                        Number of samples to use for training.
  --max-seq-length MAX_SEQ_LENGTH
  --seed SEED
  --learning-rate LEARNING_RATE
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
  --data-path DATA_PATH
                        A Hugging Face dataset which is compatible with an mlx-lm dataset format.
  --grad-checkpoint     Use gradient checkpointing to reduce memory use.
  --target-dir TARGET_DIR
                        Directory to save/load targets.
  --targets-only        Compute the targets and exit.
  --pipeline            Use pipeline parallel instead of data parallel.
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading.

commands.name: mlx_lm.dynamic_quant
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.dynamic_quant [-h] [--model MODEL] [--mlx-path MLX_PATH] [--seed SEED]
                            [--sensitivities SENSITIVITIES] [--target-bpw TARGET_BPW]
                            [--low-bits LOW_BITS] [--low-group-size LOW_GROUP_SIZE]
                            [--high-bits HIGH_BITS] [--high-group-size HIGH_GROUP_SIZE]
                            [--report-ppl] [--grad-checkpoint]
                            [--accumulation-dtype {float32,bfloat16}] [--trust-remote-code]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL, -m MODEL
  --mlx-path MLX_PATH   Path to save the model
  --seed SEED
  --sensitivities SENSITIVITIES
                        Path to a pre-computed sensitivity JSON file.
  --target-bpw TARGET_BPW
                        Target bits per weight.
  --low-bits LOW_BITS
  --low-group-size LOW_GROUP_SIZE
  --high-bits HIGH_BITS
  --high-group-size HIGH_GROUP_SIZE
  --report-ppl          Compute the perplexity of the base and quantized models.
  --grad-checkpoint     Use gradient checkpointing to reduce memory use.
  --accumulation-dtype {float32,bfloat16}
                        What type to use to accumulate the gradients for the sensitivities
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading.

commands.name: mlx_lm.evaluate
commands.help:
usage: Evaluate an MLX model using lm-evaluation-harness. [-h] --model MODEL --tasks TASKS
                                                          [TASKS ...] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR]
                                                          [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
                                                          [--num-shots NUM_SHOTS]
                                                          [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]
                                                          [--limit LIMIT] [--seed SEED]
                                                          [--fewshot-as-multiturn]
                                                          [--apply-chat-template | --no-apply-chat-template]
                                                          [--chat-template-args CHAT_TEMPLATE_ARGS]
                                                          [--confirm-run-unsafe-code]
                                                          [--trust-remote-code] [--temp TEMP]
                                                          [--top-p TOP_P] [--top-k TOP_K]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         Model to evaluate
  --tasks TASKS [TASKS ...]
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Output directory for result files.
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                        Maximum number of sequences processed at once, both when scoring and when
                        generating.
  --num-shots NUM_SHOTS
                        Number of shots
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
                        Maximum number of tokens to generate. When set, this value takes
                        precedence over task specific defaults.
  --limit LIMIT         Limit the number of examples per task.
  --seed SEED           Random seed.
  --fewshot-as-multiturn
                        Whether to provide the fewshot examples as a multiturn conversation or a
                        single user turn.
  --apply-chat-template, --no-apply-chat-template
                        Specifies whether to apply a chat template to the prompt. If the model has
                        a chat template, this defaults to `True`, otherwise `False`.
  --chat-template-args CHAT_TEMPLATE_ARGS
                        A JSON formatted string of arguments for the tokenizer's
                        apply_chat_template, e.g. '{"enable_thinking":false}'
  --confirm-run-unsafe-code
                        Confirm that you want to run tasks that execute untrusted code.
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer
  --temp TEMP           Sampling temperature
  --top-p TOP_P         Sampling top-p
  --top-k TOP_K         Sampling top-k

commands.name: mlx_lm.fuse
commands.help:
Loading pretrained model
usage: mlx_lm.fuse [-h] [--model MODEL] [--save-path SAVE_PATH] [--adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH]
                   [--upload-repo UPLOAD_REPO] [--dequantize] [--export-gguf]
                   [--gguf-path GGUF_PATH] [--trust-remote-code]

Fuse fine-tuned adapters into the base model.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         The path to the local model directory or Hugging Face repo.
  --save-path SAVE_PATH
                        The path to save the fused model.
  --adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH
                        Path to the trained adapter weights and config.
  --upload-repo UPLOAD_REPO
                        The Hugging Face repo to upload the model to.
  --dequantize          Generate a dequantized model.
  --export-gguf         Export model weights in GGUF format.
  --gguf-path GGUF_PATH
                        Path to save the exported GGUF format model weights. Default is ggml-
                        model-f16.gguf.
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading.

commands.name: mlx_lm.generate
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.generate [-h] [--model MODEL] [--trust-remote-code] [--adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH]
                       [--extra-eos-token EXTRA_EOS_TOKEN [EXTRA_EOS_TOKEN ...]]
                       [--system-prompt SYSTEM_PROMPT] [--prompt PROMPT]
                       [--image IMAGE [IMAGE ...]] [--prefill-response PREFILL_RESPONSE]
                       [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--temp TEMP] [--top-p TOP_P] [--min-p MIN_P]
                       [--top-k TOP_K] [--xtc-probability XTC_PROBABILITY]
                       [--xtc-threshold XTC_THRESHOLD] [--min-tokens-to-keep MIN_TOKENS_TO_KEEP]
                       [--seed SEED] [--ignore-chat-template] [--use-default-chat-template]
                       [--chat-template-config CHAT_TEMPLATE_CONFIG] [--verbose VERBOSE]
                       [--max-kv-size MAX_KV_SIZE] [--prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE]
                       [--prompt-cache-file PROMPT_CACHE_FILE] [--quantize-activations]
                       [--kv-bits KV_BITS] [--kv-group-size KV_GROUP_SIZE]
                       [--quantized-kv-start QUANTIZED_KV_START] [--draft-model DRAFT_MODEL]
                       [--num-draft-tokens NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS]

LLM inference script

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         The path to the local model directory or Hugging Face repo. If no model is
                        specified, then mlx-community/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit is used.
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer
  --adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH
                        Optional path for the trained adapter weights and config.
  --extra-eos-token EXTRA_EOS_TOKEN [EXTRA_EOS_TOKEN ...]
                        Add tokens in the list of eos tokens that stop generation.
  --system-prompt SYSTEM_PROMPT
                        System prompt to be used for the chat template
  --prompt PROMPT, -p PROMPT
                        Message to be processed by the model ('-' reads from stdin)
  --image IMAGE [IMAGE ...]
                        Image files for the image placeholders of the prompt, in order.
  --prefill-response PREFILL_RESPONSE
                        Prefill response to be used for the chat template
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS, -m MAX_TOKENS
                        Maximum number of tokens to generate
  --temp TEMP           Sampling temperature
  --top-p TOP_P         Sampling top-p
  --min-p MIN_P         Sampling min-p
  --top-k TOP_K         Sampling top-k
  --xtc-probability XTC_PROBABILITY
                        Probability of XTC sampling to happen each next token
  --xtc-threshold XTC_THRESHOLD
                        Threshold the probs of each next token candidate to be sampled by XTC
  --min-tokens-to-keep MIN_TOKENS_TO_KEEP
                        Minimum tokens to keep for min-p sampling.
  --seed SEED           PRNG seed
  --ignore-chat-template
                        Use the raw prompt without the tokenizer's chat template.
  --use-default-chat-template
                        Use the default chat template
  --chat-template-config CHAT_TEMPLATE_CONFIG
                        Additional config for `apply_chat_template`. Should be a dictionary of
                        string keys to values represented as a JSON decodable string.
  --verbose VERBOSE     Log verbose output when 'True' or 'T' or only print the response when
                        'False' or 'F'
  --max-kv-size MAX_KV_SIZE
                        Set the maximum key-value cache size
  --prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE
                        Number of prompt tokens to process at a time. Smaller values lower peak
                        memory during prefill (default: 2048)
  --prompt-cache-file PROMPT_CACHE_FILE
                        A file containing saved KV caches to avoid recomputing them
  --quantize-activations, -qa
                        Quantize activations using the same quantization config as the
                        corresponding layer.
  --kv-bits KV_BITS     Number of bits for KV cache quantization. Defaults to no quantization.
  --kv-group-size KV_GROUP_SIZE
                        Group size for KV cache quantization.
  --quantized-kv-start QUANTIZED_KV_START
                        When --kv-bits is set, start quantizing the KV cache from this step
                        onwards.
  --draft-model DRAFT_MODEL
                        A model to be used for speculative decoding.
  --num-draft-tokens NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS
                        Number of tokens to draft when using speculative decoding.

commands.name: mlx_lm.gptq
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.gptq [-h] [--model MODEL] [--mlx-path MLX_PATH] [--bits BITS]
                   [--group-size GROUP_SIZE] [--fallback-bits FALLBACK_BITS]
                   [--fallback-group-size FALLBACK_GROUP_SIZE] [--num-samples NUM_SAMPLES]
                   [--sequence-length SEQUENCE_LENGTH] [--seed SEED] [--trust-remote-code]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL, -m MODEL
  --mlx-path MLX_PATH
  --bits BITS           Quantization bits for GPTQ layers
  --group-size GROUP_SIZE
                        Quantization group size for GPTQ layers
  --fallback-bits FALLBACK_BITS
                        Quantization bits for non-GPTQ layers
  --fallback-group-size FALLBACK_GROUP_SIZE
                        Quantization group size for non-GPTQ layers
  --num-samples NUM_SAMPLES
                        Number of samples from the calibration dataset, use -1 for all.
  --sequence-length SEQUENCE_LENGTH
                        Sequence length for the calibration data.
  --seed SEED
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading.

commands.name: mlx_lm.lora
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.lora [-h] [--model MODEL] [--train] [--data DATA]
                   [--fine-tune-type {lora,dora,full}]
                   [--optimizer {adam,adamw,muon,sgd,adafactor}] [--mask-prompt]
                   [--num-layers NUM_LAYERS] [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE] [--iters ITERS]
                   [--val-batches VAL_BATCHES] [--learning-rate LEARNING_RATE]
                   [--steps-per-report STEPS_PER_REPORT] [--steps-per-eval STEPS_PER_EVAL]
                   [--grad-accumulation-steps GRAD_ACCUMULATION_STEPS]
                   [--resume-adapter-file RESUME_ADAPTER_FILE] [--adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH]
                   [--save-every SAVE_EVERY] [--test] [--test-batches TEST_BATCHES]
                   [--max-seq-length MAX_SEQ_LENGTH] [-c CONFIG] [--grad-checkpoint]
                   [--clear-cache-threshold CLEAR_CACHE_THRESHOLD] [--report-to REPORT_TO]
                   [--project-name PROJECT_NAME] [--seed SEED] [--trust-remote-code]

LoRA or QLoRA finetuning.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         The path to the local model directory or Hugging Face repo.
  --train               Do training
  --data DATA           Directory with {train, valid, test}.jsonl files or the name of a Hugging
                        Face dataset (e.g., 'mlx-community/wikisql')
  --fine-tune-type {lora,dora,full}
                        Type of fine-tuning to perform: lora, dora, or full.
  --optimizer {adam,adamw,muon,sgd,adafactor}
                        Optimizer to use for training: adam, adamw, sgd, or adafactor.
  --mask-prompt         Mask the prompt in the loss when training
  --num-layers NUM_LAYERS
                        Number of layers to fine-tune. Default is 16, use -1 for all.
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                        Minibatch size.
  --iters ITERS         Iterations to train for.
  --val-batches VAL_BATCHES
                        Number of validation batches, -1 uses the entire validation set.
  --learning-rate LEARNING_RATE
                        Adam learning rate.
  --steps-per-report STEPS_PER_REPORT
                        Number of training steps between loss reporting.
  --steps-per-eval STEPS_PER_EVAL
                        Number of training steps between validations.
  --grad-accumulation-steps GRAD_ACCUMULATION_STEPS
                        Number of steps to accumulate before each optimizer update.
  --resume-adapter-file RESUME_ADAPTER_FILE
                        Load path to resume training from the given fine-tuned weights.
  --adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH
                        Save/load path for the fine-tuned weights.
  --save-every SAVE_EVERY
                        Save the model every N iterations.
  --test                Evaluate on the test set after training
  --test-batches TEST_BATCHES
                        Number of test set batches, -1 uses the entire test set.
  --max-seq-length MAX_SEQ_LENGTH
                        Maximum sequence length.
  -c CONFIG, --config CONFIG
                        A YAML configuration file with the training options
  --grad-checkpoint     Use gradient checkpointing to reduce memory use.
  --clear-cache-threshold CLEAR_CACHE_THRESHOLD
                        Clear the allocator cache between steps if it grows too large.
  --report-to REPORT_TO
                        Services to report logs to ('wandb', 'swanlab', or 'wandb,swanlab').
  --project-name PROJECT_NAME
                        Project name for logging. Defaults to the name of the root directory.
  --seed SEED           The PRNG seed
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading.

commands.name: mlx_lm.manage
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.manage [-h] [--scan] [--delete] [--pattern PATTERN]

MLX Model Cache.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --scan             Scan Hugging Face cache for mlx models.
  --delete           Delete models matching the given pattern.
  --pattern PATTERN  Model repos contain the pattern.

commands.name: mlx_lm.perplexity
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.perplexity [-h] --model MODEL [--trust-remote-code] [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
                         [--sequence-length SEQUENCE_LENGTH] [--num-samples NUM_SAMPLES]
                         [--data-path DATA_PATH] [--seed SEED]

Evaluate perplexity of MLX models

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         Path to model or Hugging Face model ID
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer/model loading from Hugging Face.
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
                        Batch size for evaluation
  --sequence-length SEQUENCE_LENGTH
                        Sequence length for evaluation
  --num-samples NUM_SAMPLES
                        Number of samples to use (-1 for all available)
  --data-path DATA_PATH
                        A Hugging Face dataset which is compatible with an mlx-lm dataset format.
  --seed SEED           Random seed for data sampling

commands.name: mlx_lm.server
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.server [-h] [--model MODEL] [--adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH] [--host HOST]
                     [--port PORT] [--allowed-origins ALLOWED_ORIGINS] [--draft-model DRAFT_MODEL]
                     [--num-draft-tokens NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS] [--trust-remote-code]
                     [--log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR,CRITICAL}]
                     [--chat-template CHAT_TEMPLATE] [--use-default-chat-template] [--temp TEMP]
                     [--top-p TOP_P] [--top-k TOP_K] [--min-p MIN_P] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]
                     [--chat-template-args CHAT_TEMPLATE_ARGS]
                     [--decode-concurrency DECODE_CONCURRENCY]
                     [--prompt-concurrency PROMPT_CONCURRENCY]
                     [--prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE]
                     [--prompt-cache-size PROMPT_CACHE_SIZE]
                     [--prompt-cache-bytes PROMPT_CACHE_BYTES] [--kv-bits KV_BITS]
                     [--kv-group-size KV_GROUP_SIZE] [--quantized-kv-start QUANTIZED_KV_START]
                     [--pipeline]

MLX Http Server.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         The path to the MLX model weights, tokenizer, and config
  --adapter-path ADAPTER_PATH
                        Optional path for the trained adapter weights and config.
  --host HOST           Host for the HTTP server (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --port PORT           Port for the HTTP server (default: 8080)
  --allowed-origins ALLOWED_ORIGINS
                        Allowed origins (default: *)
  --draft-model DRAFT_MODEL
                        A model to be used for speculative decoding.
  --num-draft-tokens NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS
                        Number of tokens to draft when using speculative decoding.
  --trust-remote-code   Enable trusting remote code for tokenizer
  --log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR,CRITICAL}
                        Set the logging level (default: INFO)
  --chat-template CHAT_TEMPLATE
                        Specify a chat template for the tokenizer
  --use-default-chat-template
                        Use the default chat template
  --temp TEMP           Default sampling temperature (default: 0.0)
  --top-p TOP_P         Default nucleus sampling top-p (default: 1.0)
  --top-k TOP_K         Default top-k sampling (default: 0, disables top-k)
  --min-p MIN_P         Default min-p sampling (default: 0.0, disables min-p)
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
                        Default maximum number of tokens to generate (default: 512)
  --chat-template-args CHAT_TEMPLATE_ARGS
                        A JSON formatted string of arguments for the tokenizer's
                        apply_chat_template, e.g. '{"enable_thinking":false}'
  --decode-concurrency DECODE_CONCURRENCY
                        When a request is batchable then decode that many requests in parallel
  --prompt-concurrency PROMPT_CONCURRENCY
                        When a request is batchable then process that many prompts in parallel
  --prefill-step-size PREFILL_STEP_SIZE
                        Step size for prefill processing (default: 2048)
  --prompt-cache-size PROMPT_CACHE_SIZE
                        Maximum number of distinct KV caches to hold in the prompt cache
  --prompt-cache-bytes PROMPT_CACHE_BYTES
                        Maximum size in bytes of the KV caches
  --kv-bits KV_BITS     Number of bits for KV cache quantization (e.g., 4 or 8). Reduces memory
                        usage for long contexts. Disables batching, so requests are served one at
                        a time. Default: None (full precision)
  --kv-group-size KV_GROUP_SIZE
                        Group size for KV cache quantization (default: 64)
  --quantized-kv-start QUANTIZED_KV_START
                        Token position to start KV cache quantization (default: 5000)
  --pipeline            Use pipelining instead of tensor parallelism

commands.name: mlx_lm.share
commands.help:
usage: mlx_lm.share [-h] [--path PATH] [--model MODEL] [--hostfile HOSTFILE] [--dst DST]
                    [--tmpdir TMPDIR]

Distribute a model to other nodes using MLX distributed.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --path PATH          Path to a file or folder to share.
  --model MODEL        The path to a local model or Hugging Face repo
  --hostfile HOSTFILE  The file containing the hosts and connection information
  --dst DST            The destination path in other nodes (defaults to --path or --model)
  --tmpdir TMPDIR      Intermediate temporary directory to ensure successfull transfer

usage: mlx_lm.upload [-h] [--path PATH] [--upload-repo UPLOAD_REPO]

Upload a model to the Hugging Face Hub

options:

  --path PATH           Path to the MLX model.
  --upload-repo UPLOAD_REPO
                        The Hugging Face repo to upload the model to.
